question: How does one become free from all the bonds present in the person?
premises: There are bonds both stated and unstated, described in the Paratantra.
All these bonds are present in the person.
By purifying them there, one is released from becoming.
inference: Liberation from becoming comes through purifying all bonds present in the person.
uncertainties: The specific method of purification is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: All the bonds, whether stated or unstated and described in the Paratantra, are present in the person. By purifying them there, one is freed from worldly becoming.
